cases.source: <?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\AuthProfiles; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\ProfileChange; use Runa\Support\Modules\Api\ModuleApis; function profile(ModuleApis $apis, string $id, int $version): void { $apis->resolve('runa.auth', AuthProfiles::class, '1.0.0')->edit($id, $version, new ProfileChange(name: 'Example')); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Permissions\Contracts\PermissionsAccess; use Runa\Modules\Permissions\Contracts\AssignmentPreview; function apply(PermissionsAccess $access, AssignmentPreview $reviewed): array { return $access->applyAssignments($reviewed); }
<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Audit\Contracts\AuditReads; use Runa\Modules\Audit\Contracts\AuditQuery; function history(AuditReads $reads, AuditQuery $query): void { $reads->page($query); }
